summary: TOP Financial Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a proxy statement for an extraordinary general meeting on May 27, 2026. The meeting seeks shareholder approval to increase authorized share capital from $1M (1B shares) to $20M (20B shares) by creating additional Class A and Class B ordinary shares, and to adopt amended articles of association reflecting the increase. No price, premium, or strategic transaction is proposed. Shareholders are urged to vote by proxy. While a capital increase may precede future transactions, the filing itself is a routine governance matter.
